title: castilleja rubicundula subsp. lithospermoides
intro: Castilleja rubicundula subsp. lithospermoides, commonly known as Mountain Indian paintbrush, is a species of flowering plant in the plantain family (Plantaginaceae). It is native to the western United States and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant has been reported to have antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various ailments such as wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Castilleja rubicundula subsp. lithospermoides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
